messages:
ops-bot: PAGER: Elevated error rate and increased 5xx for /v1/generate in us-west detected (threshold tripped). Pager sent to @oncall_tony. Alerting: latency spike + partial throughput drop.

oncall_tony: Acked. Investigating now — seeing a spike in OOMs on a subset of gen pods. Marking P1.
alex_k: Can we draft a short status update for status.redwood.ai? Customers will ask.
maya: Suggest impact wording: "Customers in us-west may see increased latency or failed requests for text generation. We are actively mitigating." Keep it concise.
emily_g: Looping in legal for any required phrasing for customer notices. @legal_jane FYI.
legal_jane: Thanks — no legal blockers, just avoid implying SLA credit language.
product_sam: ETA? Is there a straightforward mitigation we can apply quickly?
oncall_tony: Rolling a routing change to divert traffic to smaller sequence model (gen-lite) and enabling extra replicas. Patching KV cache handling as we speak. Running canary now.
ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: Canary route created -> 10% traffic to gen-lite. Monitoring errors and tail latency.
alex_k: Draft for initial status page (short):
```
We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for text generation in the us-west region. Some requests to the /v1/generate endpoint may return 5xx or timeout. Our on-call team is actively mitigating; we will post updates every ~15 minutes or as status changes.
```
maya: Minor edit: add affected timeframe and mention workaround. Proposed: "Affected since ~09:02 UTC. Workaround: retrying requests or routing to other regions."
alex_k: Updated draft:```
Investigating: Elevated error rates and increased latency for text generation (us-west). A subset of generation requests to /v1/generate may return 5xx or time out. Issue started ~09:02 UTC. On-call is mitigating; temporary routing and model fallback are in progress. Workarounds: retry requests or route to other regions. Updates every ~15 minutes.
```
emily_g: I suggest replacing "route to other regions" with "route to other regions if possible" — avoid promising cross-region automatic failover.
legal_jane: +1 emily_g.
product_sam: Also add whether embeddings or other endpoints are affected?
oncall_tony: Confirmed: embeddings and embeddings endpoints unaffected. Only generation endpoints impacted.
alex_k: Final check: ready to publish after signoff. @legal_jane ok?
legal_jane: Approved.
ops-bot: ACTION: status page initial entry queued.
alex_k: Publishing now. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4998001234 (internal link) :rocket:
maya: :thumbsup: good. Please pin the link in the incident doc.
oncall_tony: Canary looks good — error rate in canary is low. Rolling full routing adjustments to route ~80% to gen-lite as fallback.
ops-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 09:12 UTC — observed 40% reduction in 5xx after routing change.
product_sam: Nice. Can we add a brief customer-facing update saying mitigation in progress with partial recovery?
alex_k: Posting update to status page:```
Update (09:12 UTC): Mitigation in progress. We have routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model and enabled additional replicas which has reduced 5xx errors by ~40%. Users may still see transient failures; we continue to monitor.
```
emily_g: LGTM.
oncall_tony: Continuing to patch root cause (KV cache handling). Patch applied to canary, validating.
ops-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 09:22 UTC — error rate trending to baseline in canary, overall cluster errors down ~75% vs peak.
alex_k: Drafting resolved copy if we confirm recovery:```
Resolved (09:28 UTC): The issue causing elevated error rates and increased latency for generation in us-west has been mitigated. We reverted to normal routing and applied a fix to the cache handling logic. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support. We apologize for the disruption.
```
maya: Add note: "No customer data was exposed."
legal_jane: Confirmed — add that exact line.
product_sam: Also note affected customers: all gen API users in us-west; embeddings unaffected.
oncall_tony: Verified full recovery in us-west at 09:28 UTC. No further action on-call.
ops-bot: STATUS: Resolved posted to status.redwood.ai. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4998001234/resolved :white_check_mark:
alex_k: Publishing internal incident summary to confluence and tagging postmortem owners.
emily_g: Thanks everyone. I'll monitor alerts for the next 60m.
legal_jane: Thanks, team.
product_sam: Good job moving quickly.
oncall_tony: Closing pager. :wave:
